Authoritative five-pair stereo capture session manifest
Representative side-by-side stereo image; raw eyes remain beside it and are indexed by the manifest

controlledVariables: One capture DLL, dependency revision, hardware configuration, runtime lane, null-HMD profile, save, weather identity, player position, and camera pose
Per-eye dimensions 1512x1680 and combined stereo dimensions 3024x1680
Capture-start game-hour spread across the three candidates was 0.0000658 hour
All accepted sessions used five frames at 120 compositor-cycle spacing with zero reported drops
deviations: Each settings candidate used a separate Skyrim process because the harness currently selects on-disk settings before launch.
A preceding five-pair attempt saved all requested pairs but reported one incomplete-eye drop; it was rejected and this clean r02 sequence was retained.

reasons: The authoritative manifest is complete with five saved pairs, zero failed frames, zero incomplete-eye drops, and zero backpressure drops.
Both raw eye files and the combined stereo output exist for every requested frame.
Scene, weather, player position, camera pose, and start time passed the visual-campaign alignment checks.
Acceptance covers capture integrity and exploratory within-lane comparison, not deterministic single-feature attribution in a live exterior scene.

conclusions: The Info-capable automation API produced a complete lossless HMD-stereo sequence without Developer Mode or Debug logging.
The five-frame combined-stereo average had descriptive raw sRGB channel means [27.6366, 24.0155, 23.6318].

Relative to IBL-off, enabled IBL lowers the ambient floor on roofs, deep timber, stone, and the walkway while leaving the bright sky and emissive windows broadly stable; this increases plane separation, material relief, and the scene's sheltered, high-contrast character.
Relative to Volumetric-Shadows-off, enabled Volumetric Shadows produces softer, slightly lifted shadowed geometry and a brighter, more graduated distant cliff-haze region in this capture.
The picture set is suitable for human/LLM review and for designing more deterministic shader-isolation scenes.
notes: The prior rejected sequence also warmed the capture path.
Image statistics used five combined-stereo frames per candidate, downsampled to 756x420 without linear-light conversion; they are descriptive rather than perceptual or attribution metrics.

The all-on IBL settings were DALCMode=0, DALCAmount=0, EnvIBLScale=0.75, SkyIBLScale=1.5, FogAmount=0, and PreserveFogLuminance=0. IBL therefore replaces the vanilla diffuse ambient term in this scene and does not directly recolour fog.
IBL EnableIBL and Volumetric Shadows Enabled are audited as live renderer controls, but this campaign restarted because typed API mutation and effective-state readback are not implemented yet.
Temporary MO2 and SteamVR configuration changes were restored byte-for-byte after the campaign.
